t: Im muttar leshannot tepillin shel yad leshel rosh
s: Im muttar leshannot tepillin shel yad leshel rosh ubo v' seipim: asur leshannot tepillin shel rosh laasotah shel yad, apillu en lo tepillin shel yad veyesh lo shenayim shel rosh. Vaapillu liqqach retzua mishshel rosh leshel yad — asur. Mippene sheen moridin miqqedushsha chamura liqdushsha qalla, veshel rosh qedushshato chamura, sherubbo shel shem shd"y hu beshel rosh — hashshi"n babbattim vehad' baqqesher, abal beshel yad en bo — ki im hayyu"d. Abal mishshel yad leshel rosh — muttar leshannot, sheyyaaseh lo arbaa battim betoko. Veim hayu chadashim shello henichan adayin alayv — muttar leshannot apillu mishshel rosh leshel yad, shettoleh alehem mikseh or echad veniret kebayit echad bachutz, veap shehem arbaa mibbipnim — en bekak kelum bediabad kemo shennitbaer besiman lab, veen bazeh horada miqqedushsha chamura liqdushsha qalla hemenna ap al pi shezzimmenam vehekinam letzorek harosh, lepi shehahazmana enah kelum:
Im hitna alehem mittechilla sheyyukal leshannotah leshel yad — yakol leshannotah apillu lebashan adam al rosho achar-kak:

Im nipseqa haretzua shel yad samuk laqqesher vehopek rosh hashsheni lemala veoseh bo haqqesher verosh harishon yihyeh lematta — lo yiqshor sham lematta chatikat haretzua shehaya haqqesher bah shennipseqa sham, mippene shemmoridah miqqedushshatah, kevan shehaya bah haqqesher vehayyu"d veatta yaaseh bah kerikot haetzbaot, ella tzerika geniza. Veim en haretzua arukka kol-kak — azay lo yaaseh kol-kak kerikot sebib hayyad:

Sudar shehizmino litzror bo tepillin leolam velo lepi shaa bilbad veachar-kak tzarar bo tepillin paam achat, apillu tzeraran bo lepi shaa bistam velo al daat sheyyehe meyuchad lekak leolam — neesar lehishtammesh bo debar chol kegon litzror bo maot, ella im ken hitna alayv battechilla sheyyukal litzror bo maot kesheyyirtzeh, o shebbeshaa shetztzarar bo hattepillin hitna bedato shetztzoreran bo al daat lepannotan leachar zeman veyachazor lihyot chol kemo shehaya qodem shetztzarar bo. Veim asa kis leshem tepillin apillu tzarar bo al daat lepannotan — asur. Vehu haddin im haya kis vehosip bo ezeh dabar leshem tepillin veachar-kak tzeraran bo apillu al daat lepannotan — asur ad sheyyittol mah shechiddesh. Abal im lo tzeraran bo meolam — eno neesar behazmana, apillu asa kis mechadash leshem tepillin. Veken im tzeraran bo apillu peamim rabbot lepi shaa velo hizmino meolam leshem tepillin qodem shetztzeraran bo, vegam keshetztzeraran bo lo haya az bedato sheyyitzror bo tepillin leolam — muttar lehishtammesh chol apillu beshaa shemmishtammesh bo qodesh, kegon litzror bo tepillin umaot yachad. Abal im tzeraran bo apillu paam achat al daat letzoreran bo leolam — hare zeh keillu hizmino utzeraran bo veneesar. Vekol zeh besudar o kis shello, abal adam eno oser dabar sheeno shello, ella im ken ganab beged vaasao kis, sheaz qenao beshinnuy maaseh vaasaro:

Qatan shetztzarar tepillin besudar shehizmino lekak — neesar, abal dabar hanneesar behazmana lebaddah kemo sheyyitbaer — eno neesar behazmanat qatan, mippene shecheresh shoteh veqatan yesh lahem maaseh veen lahem machashaba, apillu gillu machashabtam bedibburam:

Yesh omerim shello ameru shehazmana bilbaddah enah moelet leesor lehishtammesh bo chol ella keshehizmino lihyot tashmishe qedushsha, kegon kis shel tepillin. Veken retzuot shel tepillin — tashmishe qedushsha hen, velo gup haqqedushsha. Abal im hizmino lihyot gup haqqedushsha, kegon qelap hamubbad leshem seper tora o tepillin umezuzot — asur liktob alayv dibre chol, ella im ken hitna alayv. Abal muttar lehorido liqdushsha qalla, shehare tepillin shel rosh muttar laasotah shel yad im hem chadashim, ap al pi shehem gup haqqedushsha. Veken qelap hamubbad leshem seper tora — muttar liktob alayv tepillin umezuzot kemo shennitbaer besiman lab, ap al pi sheqqedushshat seper tora gedola miqqedushshatan. Veget lo niqra dabar shebbiqdushsha kelal, veasur lekotbo al qelap hamubbad leshem seper tora ella im ken hitna. Veyesh omerim sheap begup haqqedushsha — hazmana enah kelum, ad sheyyaaseh bo maaseh shel gup haqqedushsha, kegon sheyyatchil liktob al haqqelap seper tora o tepillin umezuzot, vehu haddin shear kitbe haqqodesh apillu al hanneyar. Veaz asur liktob alayv dibre chol apillu hitna alayv battechilla, lepi shelledibre hakkol en tenay moil begup haqqedushsha lehishtammesh bo chol keshehu biqdushshato. Abal letashmishe qedushsha moil tenay ledibre hakkol apillu beodan biqdushshatan (raq sheyyishtammesh bahem shello bishat mitzvatan, kegon atarot shel seper tora littol mehen ulehannichan berosh chatanim), kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qanad. Ubilbad shello yehe tashmish megunneh, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qana. Abal tashmishe mitzva, kegon: tzitzit, shopar, lulab, ner chanukka — en tzarik litnay kelal ledibre hakkol, sheapillu asaan leshem kak beli shum tenay venaaset bahem mitzvatan peamim rabbot — muttar lehishtammesh bahem chol. Raq shello yishtammesh bahem bishat mitzvatan, kegon liqshor ezeh dabar bechute tzitzit hatteluyim babbeged kemo shennitbaer besiman ka (veen tzarik lomar betashmishe qedushsha, kegon likrok ezeh dabar baretzua haqqabua bitpillin shealayv, sheapillu tenay eno moil bazeh mishshum bizzuy mitzva). Uleinyan halaka — yesh lehachamir kassebara harishona, ap al pi shehaiqqar kassebara hashsheniyya. Veap-al-pi-ken nahagu akshav liktob gittin uqemeot al qelap hamubbad leshem seper tora, lepi shekkevan shennahagu ken — hare zeh keillu hitna alayv mittechilla, shehare keshehassoperim metaqqenim otan — metaqqenim otan al daat lehishtammesh bo hen lidbar qedushsha hen lidbar hareshut, kevan shemminhagam bekak. (Veken mah shennahagu harbeh bene adam shemmishtammeshin bassaq shel tepillin keshehem badderek hu mittaam zeh, shekkevan shennahagu ken — hare zeh keillu hitnu alayv kesheasauhu o kesheqqenauhu sheyyishtammeshu bo badderek keminhagam):
